scripts.dev: npm run build -w @igetjobs/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @igetjobs/api" "npm run dev -w @igetjobs/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @igetjobs/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @igetjobs/shared && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
